title: corylus kweichowensis var. sutchuenensis
intro: Corylus kweichowensis var. sutchuenensis, commonly known as Sichuan hazelnut or Chinese hazelnut, is a plant species in the family Betulaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, headache, and rheumatism, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of Corylus kweichowensis var. sutchuenensis have been reported to have potential therapeutic applications in the treatment of various diseases, including cancer and neurodegenerative disorders.
